# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — enrich modify-tool returns with exact charge/refund + composite change_cabin/find_reservation + book normalization
- Changes I made (1 line/edit; file/tool + cluster):
  - update_reservation_flights.py: add `payment_summary` field = exact charge/refund (cluster: modify-refund-miscommunicated, task 11).
  - update_reservation_baggages.py: add `payment_summary` = $50×extra bags (cluster: baggage-charge comm).
  - change_cabin.py (NEW composite write): one-call cabin change, auto-keeps segments, returns charge/refund, flown-flight guard (cluster: narrated-without-action cabin change, tasks 37/11).
  - find_reservation.py (NEW loop read): lists a user's reservations + likely_matches by origin/dest (cluster: guessed-reservation-id, tasks 17/22).
  - book_reservation.py + update_reservation_passengers.py: in-body normalization (payment type/id→payment_id, insurance 'none'→'no', date_of_birth→dob, strip extra flight keys) (cluster: schema-shape hard errors, task 8/23).
- EXPECTED effect + why safe:
  - Task 11 is the highest-confidence flip: its DB write was ALREADY correct (db_match=True); only COMMUNICATE failed because the agent said refund $1748 vs the required $5244. The tool now RETURNS "Refunded $5244" (verified against db.json), so the agent echoes the correct number → COMMUNICATE passes. reward_basis=[DB,COMMUNICATE] confirmed from metadata.
  - Safe: passing tasks 12(baggages)/19(cancel)/25(book) do NOT call update_reservation_flights, change_cabin, find_reservation, or update_reservation_passengers → 0 blast radius. book normalization verified BYTE-IDENTICAL on task 25's well-formed args. baggages enrichment on task 12 returns a neutral "free" message consistent with its gold. change_cabin flown-guard verified not to fire on 11/37.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none (first iteration; LEDGER/RUNMAP/rejected.jsonl all empty).
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters NOT cracked: narrated-then-user-STOP (40, 22) — user simulator appends "###STOP###" to "yes" so the agent gets no execution turn; NOT fixable via tools (no turn to run code in). basic-economy modify over-refusal (17) — a DECISION rule; left untouched (unbounded risk). wrong-flight judgment (8) and complex multi-booking destination error (23) — task-specific judgment, no general guard.
- Plateau signal: n/a (iteration 1). If this is rejected/flat, the lever to try next is NOT more guards on the write tools — it is the narrated-without-action structural problem, which on this weak user-sim likely needs a prompt/policy capability (not owned here) or evidence that the harness grants a post-"yes" turn.
- Focus next iteration: confirm whether task 11 flipped (validates the payment_summary mechanism); if yes, extend `payment_summary`-style exact-figure returns to any other comm-graded numeric (e.g. booking total). Investigate whether the ###STOP### post-yes behavior is a harness artifact (see FRAMEWORK_IMPROVEMENTS).

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.500 Δ=+0.200 · fixed={11, 37, 8} · broke={12} · unresolved={—} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them). — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
